checks: Verified owner has every admin permission without a role document
Unverified owner email cannot use administrative privileges
Lookalike and different-email accounts never become owner
A role read failure no longer destroys owner login or profile context
Denied profile reads are never treated as a missing profile to overwrite
Ordinary verified student retains ownership context and receives no admin rights
Delegated editor may edit content but cannot manage people or delegate roles
Disabled staff role removes all administrative capabilities
A client-editable profile role never grants administrator rights
Signed-out session removes previous role and profile context
Navigation preserves nested active groups and query parameters
Every admin destination resolves to its intended module
Unknown routes cannot silently become student or user-management pages
Fresh auth bootstrap includes readable issue recovery and explicit readiness
scope: Actual auth/access modules with simulated Firebase reads. Rules are statically inspected separately; live Firebase and real-browser tests are not included.
